text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it carefully. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and check my emails first. I take a proper lunch break around noon to stay focused. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either jogging or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, and plan the next day. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel balanced and productive.
